svg.desc: ONB-S03 example · Private detail: ONB-S01/03/04/05/06/07 · Account binding, shared trust checks and conditional activation. Logical responsibility groups; connector, certificate, records and Routing allocations require owner qualification. Shared behaviour does not prove implementation reuse. Provider and Spain rules remain selected contract bindings. Readiness, route activation and invoice outcomes are separate. Signing and use-time rechecks belong to runtime features. Source: SPEC-SEI-002; recovery: SPEC-SEI-004; protected-source readiness: SPEC-SEI-001. No endpoint is approved here.
svg.text: Spain onboarding · Connect a private provider
ONB-S03 example · Private detail: ONB-S01/03/04/05/06/07 · Account binding, shared trust checks and conditional activation.
Proposed logical sequence · Participants are responsibility groups; actual service placement and contracts remain open.
Solid filled arrow: request · Dashed open arrow: response · Solid open arrow: notification · Time runs down.
Common: shared behaviour · Scenario-specific: selected path · Conditional: only when required · opt: optional group · alt: alternatives
opt · Conditional · Selected private function needs account binding or missing configuration
alt · Conditional · Valid existing certificate / confirmed problem / unavailable or ambiguous evidence
opt · Conditional · Certificate required; obtain current readiness or refresh missing/stale evidence
opt · Conditional · Run only required missing or stale provider checks
alt · Conditional · Valid unchanged route / required authorised activation / failed or unknown checks
1 · Common · Capture requested functions; acknowledge saved request
Save the work item, request key and input digest. A
repeated key with the same input returns the
2 · Common · Check business identity and authority; assess current setup
If authority is missing, expired or unknown, stop affected checks. Save the
reason and required action. Return the scoped result through ONB-11.
ONB-02 · Main path below assumes authority passed
Record the per-function plan. Reuse only valid matching evidence. A failed or incomplete lookup remains
unknown; it does not prove no existing setup. Valid unchanged functions need no new external work.
Bind the existing provider account with permission. Keep the provider unless a supported change was requested.
New enrolment, subscription or publication needs a contract requirement and separate authority; configure only
ONB-05 · External changes require saved intent and recovery controls
3 · Common · Check access and trust requirements
NOT_REQUIRED needs approved policy evidence. UNDETERMINED blocks dependent work. Keep business NIF, caller
authentication and action authority separate. Evaluate each access or signing purpose separately.
The qualified Tax/certificate capability resolves authorised existing references
and validates suitability. Confirm the subject or authorised representative,
purpose, role, environment, source/material version, validity and effective
grant. It owns certificate controls; E-Invoice Service receives no key bytes.
SPEC-001 CERT-03/04/05 · Source and execution owner require ONB-Q06
Valid existing certificate: reuse its protected reference and current scoped decision. No repeat upload. This
decision does not perform authentication or sign an invoice.
Confirmed missing, expired, revoked or unsuitable required certificate
Hold dependent work. Return the confirmed reason and correction owner through ONB-11. The approved SPEC-001
process supplies replacement or corrected evidence. Recheck the affected parent gate.
ONB-08 · SPEC-004 OFR-03/08 · No automatic signer change
Unavailable, stale, ambiguous or unqualified source contract
Keep readiness unconfirmed. Do not infer missing material or request another upload. SPEC-004 permits only
qualified safe-read retry or owned escalation. Resume this check after reliable evidence returns.
ONB-08 · SPEC-004 OFR-02/04/07/08 · No mutation inferred
The main path continues only when the verified business NIF, required certificate readiness and effective
action authority pass. Failed or unknown checks return owned actions; independently valid functions remain
ONB-06 · Credential checks precede dependent platform operations
4 · Scenario-specific · Check private functions; activate only when required
Inspect current entry-point evidence first. Publish or change only when the plan and contract require it, after
saving original intent and operation identity. A possible effect uses ONB-08 / SPEC-004; do not repeat it
ONB-06 · ONB-D06 · A qualified mutation is a separate operation
Valid unchanged route: retain its current version and evidence. Return the result without a route commit or
Required initial activation or supported platform change; all prerequisite checks passed
Continue only with current readiness, qualified external observations, effective authority, the expected route
version and an approved boundary. Private A to Private B stays gated by SPEC-014 and the product decision.
Keep earlier invoice context and in-flight bindings. Release old access and dependencies only at separate
approved gates. A post-cutover failure opens an owned restoration case.
Failed or unknown checks, conflict or possible external effect
Hold unsafe dependent work and return the owner and next action. Preserve independently valid functions.
SPEC-004 resolves the original operation and resumes its exact parent gate; recovered success cannot commit a
5 · Common · Return results and required actions
Save check results, evidence, limitations, recheck conditions and next action owner before notification. Keep
setup, readiness and independently evidenced activation separate.
The ERP can read the result after receipt, on notification or after a missed
notification. Each read rechecks access; a notification is not the result itself.
Business NIF; caller identity; scoped grant
No activation claim without owning evidence
Readiness does not mean active exchange
Logical responsibility groups; connector, certificate, records and Routing allocations require owner qualification.
Shared behaviour does not prove implementation reuse. Provider and Spain rules remain selected contract bindings.
Readiness, route activation and invoice outcomes are separate. Signing and use-time rechecks belong to runtime features.
Source: SPEC-SEI-002; recovery: SPEC-SEI-004; protected-source readiness: SPEC-SEI-001. No endpoint is approved here.
